name: FlowSOM
description: Clusters flow cytometry data with a self-organising map and consensus metaclustering (FlowSOM). Version 2 is a Rust implementation without the R runtime; on the 1.x unit test it gives the same cluster and metacluster for every cell. Since 2.2 it also writes the trained map (codes, node medians and counts, metaclustering) as JSON on every channel row, for the FlowSOM tree operator to draw.

properties.name: nclust
properties.description: Number of metaclusters. Leave as NULL to let maxMeta choose. Setting this is the reproducible choice and the faster one.

properties.name: maxMeta
properties.description: Largest number of metaclusters to consider; FlowSOM picks the elbow of the within-cluster sum of squares. Ignored when nclust is set. If neither is set, 10 is used.

properties.name: seed
properties.description: Seed for the random draws that build and metacluster the map. Must be non-negative: the same seed gives the same clusters, which is what makes a workflow re-runnable.

properties.name: rlen
properties.description: Passes over the data while training the map.

properties.name: mst
properties.description: Training rounds. Only 1 is supported; above that FlowSOM retrains on distances from a minimum spanning tree of the codes, which is not ported.

properties.name: alpha_1
properties.description: Learning rate at the start of training.

properties.name: alpha_2
properties.description: Learning rate at the end of training.

properties.name: distf
properties.description: Distance: 1 Manhattan, 2 Euclidean, 3 Chebyshev, 4 cosine. FlowSOM's default is 2.

properties.name: scale
properties.description: Centre each channel and divide by its standard deviation before training. Off by default: FlowSOM 2.x and the Python FlowSOM do not scale, and on asinh-transformed data with per-channel cofactors scaling gives dim markers the weight of bright lineage markers. FlowSOM 1.22 (and the R operator, which inherits its default) scaled; set true to reproduce those.

properties.name: train_factor
properties.description: Column factor naming which cells train the map. Empty trains on every cell, as the R operator does. Set it (with train_value) to train on a subset — CytoNorm's batch controls — and assign every cell to that map, as FlowSOM's NewData does.

properties.name: train_value
properties.description: Value of train_factor that marks a training cell. The CytoNorm operators use Train.

properties.name: train_cells
properties.description: At most this many training cells, a seeded draw from the matching ones; 0 uses all of them. cytonormpy trains its FlowSOM on 6000 reference cells.

metaFactors.name: Observation
metaFactors.description: Cell, event or observation identifier. Every cell needs a value for every channel: the map clusters whole cells.
